title: Gema dari Binèh Banda .
intro: Lam saboh banda nyang ka jipiôh nibak bimbingan ilahi, sidroe tokoh nyang sidroe-droe teuka nibak pinggiran banda, jimeu-ulang-ulang ngon peusan harapan ngon peuingat. Jiwa nyang ka tuwoe nyoe teuma jeuet keu simbol abadi iman nyang teuga.
clues: Lon kalon utusan-utosan nyang jikirém u banda lon, teuma umat lon ji-anggap awaknyan lagée manusia biasa.
Lon peucaya keu peusan awaknyan dan lon rasa kebenaran nyan meugema lam tuboh lon.
Ulôn lakée umat Lôn mangat jitaát ubak utosan-utusan nyang hana jilakée upah.
Lon plung dari ujong kota nyang paleng jioh, deungon sigap lon cuba peugot awaknyan jikalon akai.
Umat ​​Ulôn jibeudôh jilawan Ulôn, dan Ulôn jipoh maté, teuma Ulôn meuteumé damé nyang keukai.
Allah geupeugah bak ulôn, ‘Tamong lam syuruga,’ dan ulôn meuharap umat ulôn djeuët keu saksi keuhormatan njang ka geubri keu ulôn.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Meuhadapi umat kafir nyang poh gobnyan .
Teungoh jitiek lam apui nyang teungoh meuapui-apui .
trial.answer: Meuhadapi umat kafir nyang poh gobnyan .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Syahid dan tamong sigra lam syuruga .
outcome.answer: Syahid dan tamong sigra lam syuruga .

verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
